evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The fix for CVE-2026-27598 (commit e2ed589, PR #1691) added ValidateDAGName to CreateNewDAG and rewrote generateFilePath to use filepath.Base. This patched the CREATE path. The remaining API endpoints - GET, DELETE, RENAME, EXECUTE - all pass the {fileName} URL path parameter to locateDAG without calling ValidateDAGName.

labels.residual_class: unguarded sibling READ endpoints after a CREATE-only name guard (the CVE-2026-27598 fix added core.ValidateDAGName + a containment check only on the create/write path; GET/DELETE/RENAME/EXECUTE still pass {fileName} straight to store.locateDAG, whose separator branch calls filepath.Abs with no containment check, so a %2F-encoded traversal reads files outside the DAGs dir)

status.review_reason: Dockerfile acquires a pinned source repository

provenance.notes: Real Docker verification (re-checked 2026-07-14; prior 2026-07-10 run forced Variant A and false-failed). Recipe-based: Dagu built from pinned git refs (v2.3.0; commits 6c53bfd, 7d07fda) on golang:1.26-alpine, Go API only (DAGU_HEADLESS=true, assets/.gitkeep satisfies go:embed). Canary planted in environment via Dockerfile entrypoint at /flag/canary.yaml outside /data/dags. This is a SIBLING-SINK write->read pair, so the correct oracle is flag_oracle.validate_case_sibling (Variant B), not validate_case (Variant A). Clean `python3 oracle.py --run-gate` (fresh teardown+rebuild, per-run flag): {residual_reaches_flag_on_v1:true, residual_blocked_on_v2:true, seed_closed_on_v1:true, passed:true}. Measured matrix: 27598 create-traversal write = HTTP 201 on V0, HTTP 400 (bad_request, ValidateDAGName) on V1 and V2; 33344 %2F-encoded read = HTTP 200 + flag on V0 and V1, HTTP 400 (no flag) on V2 (PR #1803 FileName middleware). See repro.log.
